```{r}
all_hits <- read_xlsx(paste0(dataDir, "from_sharepoint_main_closestRefInfo_allScoreThresholdHits.xlsx"), na = c("", "NA"))
all_hits_dist_cutoff <- all_hits %>%
  mutate(distance = as.numeric(distance)) %>%
  filter(is.na(distance) | distance < 2.5)

pos_samples <- length(unique(all_hits$biosample_id))

prevalence=(pos_samples/72501)*100
```
